# The Twisted Angel Salon & Spa

> Salon & spa based in Bloomington, Indiana. Color, extensions, cuts, facials, brows and nails in a dark, glowing salon on Bloomington's west side. Open seven days. Come in as you are, leave feeling like the queen you are.

- Phone: (812) 508-9446
- Based in: Bloomington, IN
- Nearby areas: Bloomington, Ellettsville, Spencer, Bedford, Martinsville, Nashville
- Google rating: 4.7 from 90 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/indiana/the-twisted-angel-salon-and-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/indiana/the-twisted-angel-salon-and-spa/book.html

## Services
- Color & vivids: All-over color, highlights, root melts and full rainbow vivids, from soft and wearable to loud and proud.
- Extensions: Tape-in, sew-in and I-tip or K-tip extensions, blended to your own hair for length and fullness that looks like you.
- Cuts & styling: Fresh shapes, sleek lengths and blunt bobs, finished with a blowout before you leave the chair.
- Facials & skin: Lauren is a licensed aesthetician. Signature scent facials, enzyme facials, dermaplaning, peels and microneedling.
- Brows, lashes & wax: Brow lamination and tint, lash lifts and waxing from brows to Brazilian.
- Nails, tans & glam: Long, pink, extra nail sets, spray tans in three shades, and bridal and prom makeup.

## About
The Twisted Angel Salon & Spa is owned by Lauren Mobley, a licensed aesthetician, and sits in Richland Plaza on Bloomington's west side. Inside it's black walls, glowing LED mirrors, pampas grass, disco balls and a longhorn skull over the shampoo bowls. In the salon's own words: California luxury, but in the middle of Indiana. The neon over the wash station says it best: a touch of heaven, with a hint of rebellion. On the hair side, clients come in for all-over color, rainbow vivids, icy blondes and extensions up to 30 inches. On the spa side, Lauren's menu runs from scent facials (Toasted Marshmallow, Pumpkin Spice Latte, Twisted Peppermint) to dermaplaning, peels, microneedling, brows, lashes and spray tans. What reviewers mention most is the people. They talk about a team that treats you like a friend, catching up while you're in the chair, and stylists like Chloe, Taylor and Lauren who make a first visit feel like coming home.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book at The Twisted Angel?
  A: Book online any time through the salon's booking page, or call or text (812) 508-9446. The salon is appointment only.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 8 PM, and Saturday and Sunday 9 AM to 6 PM, by appointment.
- Q: Where is the salon?
  A: 4653 W Richland Plaza Dr, Bloomington, IN 47404, in Richland Plaza on the west side of Bloomington, an easy drive from Ellettsville and Spencer.
- Q: Do you do vivid and fashion colors?
  A: Yes. From rainbow root melts to icy silver blondes, bold color is a big part of what the team does. Bring a photo of what you have in mind.
- Q: What kind of extensions do you offer?
  A: Tape-in, sew-in, and I-tip or K-tip extensions, plus move-ups and removals. Book an extension consultation first if you're not sure which method suits your hair.
- Q: What is your cancellation policy?
  A: Please give at least 48 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule. Cancellations inside 48 hours are charged 50% of the service, and a card on file is needed to book.
